meta.task: Fix list #83 — Find real human recordings for the 19 wanted pieces + 9 Gemini themes (v4)
rules_verified: Opened each Wikimedia Commons File: page directly and quoted Author, Source, and Permission verbatim.
Zero Al Goldstein / Pandora Music repository files (explicitly rejected Saint-Saens 07 Aquarium for Pandora source).

Zero MIDI, SoundFont, Finale, or sample-library renderings (explicitly rejected Mozart K. 608 Arachno SoundFont, Haydn Finale 2007, Debussy Nuages VPO digital samples, and Kevin MacLeod Sugar Plum synth).
Zero post-1925 disc transfers claimed as PD (explicitly rejected 1942 Pierre Monteux Scheherazade 78rpm transfer).

quoted_fields.Permission: Sound recordings that were first published prior to January 1, 1926 are in the public domain in the United States. quoted_fields.Description: English: French composer Erik Satie created several works for the piano entitled Gnossienne. This is the third piece in a set of three published in 1893, and the third piece of what ultimately became seven works that shared the name Gnossienne. This rendition was performed by the La Pianista.
